description: Returns the planned departure times of one direction of a route of the TTC at one stop, on a date of the current week. A time of 24:00 or later is after midnight, on the next date.

date.description: The date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the current week. The default is today in Tbilisi.

direction.description: The direction number from transit_get_route. Required when the route has two directions.

kind.description: The kind, when two routes share the number: bus, minibus, metro, or cable_car.

language.description: The language of the names: ka or en. The default is en.

route.description: The route number (385) or the route id.

stop.description: The stop id or the stop code. The stop must be on the direction.

name: transit_get_timetable

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the timetable, RFC 3339.

date.description: The date of the times, YYYY-MM-DD.

name.description: The name of the route, usually its two ends.

number.description: The route number that the vehicle shows.

source.description: The source of the data: TTC.

stale.description: True when the TTC did not answer and the server returns a timetable it read before.

code.description: The number on the sign of a bus stop. Absent for a station of metro or cable car.

id.description: The stop id, for example 1:1000. Every transit tool that takes a stop accepts it.

kind.description: bus, metro, or cable_car. A minibus stops at a bus stop.

lat.description: The latitude of the stop, in degrees.

lon.description: The longitude of the stop, in degrees.

times.description: The planned departure times, HH:MM, in order. 24:00 or later is after midnight.

title: Timetable of a route at a stop
